card.name: Words just before the word risk
card.fires_on: Small words right before 'risk' or 'chances' in statements about something raising or lowering the risk of a disease, such as 'the', 'their', 'cancer' and 'increased'.

modes.label: Linking word before risk
modes.description: A word like 'the' or 'their' after increases/increased, directly before 'risk of' a disease.
modes.example: Alcohol increases<< the>> risk of mouth, throat, voice box

modes.label: Modifier before risk
modes.description: A modifier such as 'increased', 'lower' or 'cancer' placed immediately before 'risk'.
modes.example: the more their<< cancer>> risk increases.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word 'risk' (and its Chinese equivalents) next.
card.plain: It fires on the word just ahead of 'risk' when text says something raises or lowers the risk of disease.
